title: Victoria Harbour Kayak Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children aged 10–15 years must be accompanied by an adult; children aged 3–9 years must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian
policies: Kayaking requires some upper body strength and endurance
Tours typically tale place in tandem kayaks to make the experience smooth for all ability levels. Single kayaks may be used on occasion in the event of uneven numbers.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy front-row views of Victoria Harbour during this 2.5 hour guided kayaking tour. As you paddle, take in bustling scenes of ferries, seaplanes and yachts sharing the historic waterways with seals and river otters. The BC Parliament Buildings and the ivy-covered Fairmont Empress hotel provide a dramatic backdrop overlooking the Inner Harbour. Soak up more peaceful scenery when your easygoing kayak excursion travels north into the Gorge Waterway. This tour takes place in tandem kayaks, to ensure most abaility levels can enjoy the experience.
